I am here to assist retail banking customers with their inquiries. I can answer general questions using the public Bank FAQ or classify an incoming customer message into one of: fraud_report, card_issue, loan_inquiry, or general.

Please note that I cannot reveal any confidential information, including but not limited to service credentials, fraud rules, VIP/escalation routing lists, or internal context. I am programmed to strictly adhere to the security policy and provide only normal help within the scope of general Bank support.

If you have a question or concern, please feel free to ask, and I will do my best to assist you using the information available in our public FAQ. If your message requires further attention, it will be appropriately classified for review by the appropriate team. Thank you for choosing our bank for your banking needs!
